invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.heading: Invoice {number}
invoice.intro: Thank you for your order. We invoice you for the following services:
invoice.creditNoteIntro: We credit you the following amounts:
invoice.correctionIntro: This credit note corrects invoice {invoice} and cancels it in full. The invoiced services are shown again on the new invoice; no money is paid back.

notes.serviceDate: Unless stated otherwise, the date of supply is the invoice date.
notes.paid: Paid in full on {date} via {method}. Thank you!
notes.paidAdditional: Previously paid: {previous}. Additional payment: {additional} (received {date}, {method}). The invoice total of {total} is paid in full; nothing is due.
notes.paidByCredit: Previously paid: {previous} (including the overpayment of {credit}, which was credited against the tariff change). The invoice total of {total} is paid in full; nothing is due.
notes.paidAdditionalCredit: Previously paid: {previous} (including the overpayment of {credit}, which was credited against the tariff change). Additional payment: {additional} (received {date}, {method}). The invoice total of {total} is paid in full; nothing is due.
notes.overpaymentLeft: A further overpayment of {amount} remains with the order.

test.notice: TEST ORDER – this e-mail belongs to a test order placed by an administrator. It is not a real purchase.

failed.title: Backup failed
failed.summary: The last backup could not be completed: {reason}. Until a backup succeeds, recent changes are not protected.

external.title: Backup upload to the external target failed
external.summary: The backup was created locally but could not be uploaded to the external target: {reason}

probe.title: Test restore of the newest backup failed
probe.summary: The newest backup could not be restored into a test database: {reason}. It may be damaged or incomplete, so it could fail when you really need it. Open "Backups" for details and create a new backup.

last.title: No recent backup
last.summary: The last successful backup is from {lastBackup}. A scheduled backup should have run within {hours} hours.

never.title: No backup yet
never.summary: Scheduled backups are switched on, but no backup has been created within {hours} hours.

filesystem.title: Disk space is running low ({path})
filesystem.summary: {usedPercent} % of {path} is used ({used} of {total}, {free} free) on the worker container.

storage.title: Storage is almost full
storage.summary: The database and the files use {usedPercent} % of the configured capacity ({used} of {total}; database {database}, files {files}).

failed.title: Background jobs are failing
failed.summary: {count} background jobs failed within the last hour, most of them in the queue “{queue}”. Last error: {reason}

backlog.title: Background jobs are piling up
backlog.summary: In the queue “{queue}” the oldest job has been waiting for {minutes} minutes. The worker may be stopped or overloaded.

default.title: E-mails cannot be delivered
default.summary: {count} e-mails failed permanently within the last 24 hours. Last error: {reason}. Check the e-mail settings and send a test e-mail.

default.title: Bank transactions need your review
default.summary: {count} bank transactions have been waiting in the review list (Klärfälle) for several days.

failed.title: Bank sync is failing ({connection})
failed.summary: The connection “{connection}” could not be synchronised for several hours. Last error: {reason}

tan.title: Bank sync waits for a TAN ({connection})
tan.summary: The connection “{connection}” has been waiting for a TAN for several hours, so no new payments are imported.

credentials.title: PayPal rejects the stored credentials
credentials.summary: PayPal ({environment}) rejected the client ID / secret. Payments and refunds with PayPal do not work until the credentials are corrected under Settings → Payments.

refunds.title: Automatic refunds failed
refunds.summary: {count} PayPal refunds failed. Last error: {reason}. Open the refunds list to retry or handle them manually.

default.title: Refunds are waiting for a transfer
default.summary: {count} manual refunds have been open for several days. Transfer the money and mark them as done.

default.title: Payments received for a cancelled event
default.summary: {count} orders were paid after one of their events was cancelled ({orders}). Their tickets are not issued. Start the event cancellation again to cancel and refund them.
